title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The package stops carrying its own test suites
summary: The build script called its benchmark and maintenance bundles dev only, excluded from the package. They were not, and neither were the end to end suites, the web test harness, or the sources of the logcat panel.

highlights.title: 14 development files leave the package
highlights.description: The extension you install no longer carries its own test suites, its benchmark, or the TypeScript sources of a panel whose bundle is what loads.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: A test replays the packaging rules and fails if a development file comes back, or if an over broad rule drops the bundled standard library, a walkthrough video or a runtime bundle.
The layer that hands the version catalog its colours and fold ranges is now tested by decoding what it sends the editor and comparing it with the text it came from.
